snippet.title: Hank: Drowning On Dry Land — Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hank: Drowning On Dry Land is coming soon to Steam!

Check out the game here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1937880/Hank_Drowning_On_Dry_Land/utm_source=yt

Think BATMAN, but always DRUNK and he can TIME-TRAVEL. Sink into Hank's comic book world and escape the bad guy's trap, while playing a dangerous time-bending co-op with your past self.
